Definition: properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty)
BiblicalUsage: 1) consecration, crown, separation, Nazariteship; 1a) crown (as sign of consecration), earring; 1a1) stones of a crown, diadem, stones of charming; 1b) woman's hair; 1c) consecration; 1c1) of high priest; 1c2) of Nazarite
